description: The IMBUUID class layer for the SoMaCoSF/board fork: typed Identity (imbuuid@1), identity-committed ceilings checked at act time, a hash-linked receipt chain over Board's event log, Jev-shaped routing receipts with a local tier, and escrow released on a verified completion receipt. Self-contained: not a workspace package; it consumes the repo's @vercel/board through a local node_modules link (see README).
name: @somaco/board-class-layer
